_about: Raid writing. STAND-IN TEXT written by Opus to make the engine work; Fable rewrites all of it in F4. The engine reads: boss intro, rooms (falls back to room_pool when a boss has none), boss lines, and reactions. A room choice rolls one team stat (attack, defense, health, speed or luck). {name} is the hero who reacts, {boss} the boss, {place} the place. The narrator is neutral: no swearing, whatever Smudge's voice setting.

room_pool.text: A door, older than anyone in the team, and locked from the other side. Something behind it is breathing.

choices.label: Kick it in
choices.ok: The door gives on the second kick. The breathing stops.
choices.bad: The door holds. Somebody's ankle does not.

choices.label: Try the handle
choices.ok: It was never locked. Nobody mentions it.
choices.bad: The handle comes off in a hand. The breathing gets closer.

room_pool.text: Half the floor is gone. The other half is thinking about it.

choices.label: Run across
choices.ok: Three pairs of feet, three clean landings.
choices.bad: Somebody finds out where the floor went.

choices.label: Edge along the wall
choices.bad: The wall was the part holding the floor up.

room_pool.text: Two guards, both asleep, both enormous, both lying across the only way through.

choices.label: Tiptoe over them
choices.ok: Not a twitch. The team is through.
choices.bad: One of them wakes up mid-step and is not pleased about it.

choices.label: Wake them up properly
choices.ok: They do not stay awake for long.
choices.bad: They were only pretending to be asleep.

choices.label: Go round the long way
choices.bad: The long way has its own guards.

room_pool.text: The corridor is very clean, very quiet, and full of small holes in the walls.

choices.label: Shields up and walk
choices.ok: Darts bounce off. The team walks out tutting.
choices.bad: Darts do not bounce off everything.

choices.label: Sprint
choices.ok: The darts arrive just after everybody has left.
choices.bad: Some of the darts are faster than some of the team.

room_pool.text: A strongbox, half buried, with a note on it that says DO NOT.

choices.label: Open it
choices.ok: Inside: something useful, and a second note that says FINE.
choices.bad: Inside: a spring, a glove, and a very fast punch.

choices.label: Leave it and push on
choices.ok: The team saves its strength for what is ahead.
choices.bad: Pushing on means walking through the thing that guards the box.

room_pool.text: The weather turns, all at once, as if someone flipped it.

choices.label: Push through it
choices.bad: The cold gets into everybody's bones.

choices.label: Find shelter
choices.ok: A dry hollow, right where it needed to be.

tiber.intro: The water off the Roman dock goes very still. Then a long shape moves under it, and keeps moving, and keeps on being the same shape.

lines.open: {boss} rises out of the Tiber with most of the river still on it.
hit: {boss} lashes out with something that is mostly teeth.
A wave of river water and bad intentions hits the team.
{boss} drags somebody under for a moment, then thinks better of it.
lines.low: {boss} is slowing down. The water around it is turning a worrying colour.
lines.win: {boss} sinks back into the river and, for now, stays there.
lines.lose: The team is washed back onto the dock, coughing up the Tiber.

tony.intro: Behind the speakeasy, in the room with the safe, four gentlemen in good suits are waiting. They have been waiting a while.

lines.open: {boss} straighten their ties and crack their knuckles in the same order.
hit: One of {boss} swings a chair with real feeling.
{boss} explain, using fists, how they feel about the safe.
A gentleman in a good suit throws a very good punch.
lines.low: Two of {boss} are looking at the door.
lines.win: {boss} leave by the window. All of them. One at a time.
lines.lose: {boss} put the team out on the street and dust off their hands.

vanguard.intro: Across the wheat, a line of emus. Disciplined. Watching. One of them has a medal.

lines.open: {boss} charge, all at once, faster than anything with those legs should go.
hit: {boss} run straight through the team and turn for another go.
An emu kicks with the force of a small car.
{boss} scatter, regroup, and come back from the side.
lines.low: {boss} are thinning out. The one with the medal looks thoughtful.
lines.win: {boss} withdraw in good order. They will remember this.
lines.lose: The team retreats across the wheat. The emus do not chase. They do not need to.

gary.intro: Between the flags at Bondi, a fin, going round in slow, confident circles.

lines.open: {boss} comes up out of the surf with a mouth full of very bad news.
hit: {boss} takes a bite out of the afternoon.
{boss} thrashes, and half the rock pool goes with him.
{boss} circles once and comes back in from below.
lines.low: {boss} is swimming crooked. He is thinking about the open sea.
lines.win: {boss} heads out past the flags and keeps going.
lines.lose: The lifeguards drag the team out of the water and close the beach.

nephew.intro: Inside the Doge's vault, the Doge's nephew. He has a sword, a lot of training, and nobody has ever told him no.

lines.open: {boss} salutes, very correctly, and then attacks without waiting for anyone to salute back.
hit: {boss} lunges, perfectly, as he was taught.
{boss} disarms somebody and hands the weapon back, which is worse.
{boss} parries everything and then some.
lines.low: {boss} has started checking his hair between strikes.
lines.win: {boss} yields, very correctly, and asks not to be mentioned to his uncle.
lines.lose: {boss} has the team escorted out of the vault, politely, by eight guards.

well.intro: In the witch's clearing, the old well has a new lid, and the lid is moving.

lines.open: {boss} climbs out of the well. It takes a long time. There is a lot of it.
hit: {boss} reaches out of the dark and pulls.
Something from the well whispers, and everyone hears their own name.
{boss} lashes the clearing with roots that were not there a moment ago.
lines.low: {boss} is sinking back towards the well, as if it is tired.
lines.win: {boss} goes back down the well. The lid goes back on. Someone sits on it.
lines.lose: The team runs from the clearing and does not look back, which is wise.

antlers.intro: Under the ice at Lofoten, something with antlers is looking up at the team through a hole it made itself.

lines.open: {boss} breaks the ice from below, antlers first.
hit: {boss} swings its antlers in a wide, freezing arc.
The ice cracks under the team and {boss} is waiting underneath.
{boss} breathes out, and the cold is a weapon.
lines.low: {boss} is breathing hard. The ice around it is going soft.
lines.win: {boss} sinks back under the ice, and the hole freezes over behind it.
lines.lose: The team is pulled out of the fjord half frozen. The hole is still open.

brenda.intro: Brenda is back from leave. She has seen the supply closet. She is standing in the doorway.

lines.open: {boss} rolls up her sleeves and closes the closet door behind her.
hit: {boss} throws a stapler with frightening accuracy.
{boss} asks who used the last of the printer paper, and it hurts.
{boss} reorganises somebody, by force.
lines.low: {boss} is looking at the clock. It is nearly five.
lines.win: {boss} signs out for the day and leaves the closet to the team.
lines.lose: {boss} sends the team to HR. It is the worst thing that has happened to any of them.

hurt: {name}: I have had worse. Not recently.
boss: {name}: That is a lot bigger than the drawing.
{name}: Right. Everybody pick a side of it.
win: {name}: We should do that again. Not soon.
lose: {name}: Next time, bring a bigger team.
